# GazaBridge

> A volunteer-driven global platform connecting people in Palestine with worldwide mentors, educators, and resources through digital education, live sessions, and community support.

## Main Website
- Website: https://gazabridge.netlify.app/

## Mission
GazaBridge connects individuals in Gaza with international volunteers offering free educational mentorship, skill training, technical workshops, and real-time community engagement.

## Public Landing Pages
- Homepage: https://gazabridge.netlify.app/
- About Us: https://gazabridge.netlify.app/about
- How It Works: https://gazabridge.netlify.app/how-it-works
- Services: https://gazabridge.netlify.app/services
- Mission: https://gazabridge.netlify.app/mission
- FAQ: https://gazabridge.netlify.app/faq
- Feedback: https://gazabridge.netlify.app/feedback

## Core Offerings
- Mentorship & 1-on-1 Sessions: Direct guidance from global industry professionals.
- Digital Education & Courses: Technical, creative, and professional learning tracks.
- Community Collaboration: Real-time chat, group discussions, and shared learning materials.

## Organization Type
Non-Profit / Humanitarian Global Education Initiative.
